note: Draft Advisor front-door tree. Tree moves (adding, merging, moving or renaming any L0-L3 id) are owner-reserved; agents report findings and never move a node.

setup.owns: Machine prerequisites, the packed agent packages and the workspace files Producer creates

context.owns: One-time owner answers handed to Director as evidence, and a read-only note about sister repositories

loops.owns: The onboarding and update loops that run the front-door verbs in order
loops.doesNotOwn: Routing, cascade, release, audit and chain handoff, which stay Producer loops
